text:
Sam - Marketing: Quick sync — we need final messaging and routing for the Community Lab micro-workshop series. Two concurrent tracks: 'Refapp Deep Dives' (hands-on) and 'Bench & Cost' (results-driven). Goal: 2 launch posts, 1 webinar, email drip, and mapped inbound routing by EOW. Thoughts?
Alejandra - DevRel: +1. We should make the Refapp track super low-friction — repo + 30-min lab. Bench track needs clear benchmark narrative and a TL;DR about cost/latency wins.
Mia - Growth: For acquisition, short subject lines work best. Proposed A/B subjects: "Ship an LLM refapp in 30m" vs "Cut inference cost by 3x — real runs". Which maps to which track?
Sam - Marketing: Good call. Use first for Refapp, second for Bench. Also want a unified hero paragraph that we can reuse across posts and emails. Draft: "Join Redwood Community Labs — hands-on refapps and live benchmark sessions to make LLM inference predictable and cheap. Free, remote, 30–60m sessions."
Nate - Growth Ops: Routing note — inbound leads from Refapp CTA should go to self-serve funnel (signup + git clone). Bench webinar leads should route to nurture list (qualify by usage tier) and ping SEs for enterprise signals. I can tag routes: 
- refapp_signup -> cadence: onboard-quickstart
- bench_interest -> cadence: benchmark-nurture
Let me know properties to add to the signup form.
Alejandra - DevRel: Add fields: "primary use-case", "expected qps/month", "team size". Also ask for preferred timezones for scheduling.
Sam - Marketing: For the launch posts, proposed channels: blog, dev.to, and HN 'Show HN' for the refapp. Social copy snippets: "New: Community Labs — build a working refapp in 30 minutes with Redwood Inference. Code + tutorial + live Q&A. Sign up: <utm.link/refapp>", and "Bench: Real-world i/o — see how topology + batching cut token cost 3x. Join our live runbook: <utm.link/bench>"
Mia - Growth: Emoji + CTAs: use :rocket: for refapp, :chart_with_downwards_trend: for cost bench. Shorten UTM to track channel and creative: ?utm_source=slack&utm_campaign=lab_launch&utm_medium=post&utm_content={variant}
Kai - Product: For Bench narrative, include the model variants and hardware used (e.g., LlamaX 13B quantized on A100 vs q4_f16 on T4 — and show delta). Also be explicit about what we measured: tokens/sec, median p99 latency, tokens per dollar. 
Sam - Marketing: Draft of email hero + CTA (copy to tweak):
```
Subject: Build a refapp in 30 minutes — free Community Lab
Hi there —
Join our hands-on session and ship a small LLM refapp with Redwood Inference. We'll walk through setup, pin a model, and show cost/latency tips. No vendor lock-in.
CTA: Reserve your spot -> <utm.link/refapp>
```
Alejandra - DevRel: Love it. For the webinar blurb add a line on evaluation artifacts and a downloadable benchmark config so attendees can reproduce results.
Nate - Growth Ops: Routing checklist for me to implement: 1) Add hidden utm_source mapping to lead records; 2) Create tags (refapp, bench) + auto-assign to SDR queue for bench leads with >100k qps forecast; 3) Hook to retargeting pixel. I can have a draft flow by tomorrow.
Sam - Marketing: Who's owning the blog post + who will build the landing?
Alejandra - DevRel: I can own the refapp blog + tutorial repo (will draft code snippets). Can someone from growth review funnel events?
Mia - Growth: I will review funnel events and draft the email drip. Suggest 3 emails: welcome (how-to), follow-up (bench highlights), and nudge (join Q&A).
Kai - Product: I can provide the benchmark runbook and the sample metrics table. Also add a short quote from Eng (1-2 lines) for social posts.
campaign-bot: Reminder: Scheduled sync in 48 hours. RSVP: Alejandra, Mia, Sam, Nate, Kai.
Sam - Marketing: Perfect. Action items: Alejandra -> tutorial + code (due 72h), Mia -> email drip drafts (48h), Nate -> routing + tags (24h), Kai -> benchmark artifacts + quote (48h), Sam -> publish schedule + social calendar (48h). I'll open GH issues and the landing draft now: https://go.redwood/marketing/labs-landing-draft
Alejandra - DevRel: One more idea — make a tiny 'starter pack' with terraform + minimal infra so attendees can replicate. Will include in repo.
Mia - Growth: Also propose a short feedback NPS after the session so we can iterate messaging fast. 1–2 question pop.
Sam - Marketing: Great — we'll iterate on messaging post-session. Thanks all :tada:
